name: the-claude-factory-maintainer
description: Maintainer tooling for The Claude Factory marketplace. Not published.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate
scripts.fix: biome check --write . && ruff check --fix . && ruff format . && shfmt -w .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:workflows && npm run lint:github
scripts.lint:github: check-jsonschema --builtin-schema vendor.github-issue-forms .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/docs_issue.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/plugin_idea.yml .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/question.yml .github/VULNERABILITY_REPORT.yml && check-jsonschema --builtin-schema vendor.github-issue-config .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml && check-jsonschema --builtin-schema vendor.dependabot .github/dependabot.yml && uv run python scripts/check-github-files.py
scripts.setup: npm ci && uv sync --locked && npm run tools:install
scripts.test:scripts: uv run python -m unittest discover -s scripts/testers -t scripts -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.tools:install: uv tool install ruff==0.17.4 && uv tool install basedpyright==1.40.2 && uv tool install zizmor==1.32.0 && uv tool install check-jsonschema==0.39.0
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ts && npm run typecheck:python
scripts.validate: for d in plugins/*/; do claude plugin validate --strict "$d" || exit 1; done && claude plugin validate --strict .
